login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: CYN-96 auth spike — sign in with the disposable identity provider.
login.description: This development-only flow proves the BFF session path: the browser never sees a token, and the API is called with a bearer minted from the sealed session.
login.identityDenied: Sign-in was cancelled or denied by the identity provider.
login.disabledDescription: AUTH_MODE is off, so the disposable sign-in flow is not available. Enable it with AUTH_MODE=spike (and VITE_AUTH_MODE=spike for the client bundle).

logout.title: Sign out
logout.signedOutDescription: The refresh token was revoked and the session cookie cleared.
logout.failed: Could not complete sign-out. The local session was cleared anyway.

spike.title: Auth spike evidence
spike.subtitle: This protected page loaded through the BFF: the actor and capabilities below came from GET /api/me with a session-minted bearer.
